name: Halloumi & Veg Traybake with Couscous
method: Tray-roast the chopped courgette, peppers, onion and tomatoes with the oil and honey at 210°C for 20 minutes.
Add slices of halloumi to the tray and roast for 10 minutes more until golden.
Soak the couscous in boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff up and serve with the traybake.
